focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制全面实施在即，中国出口企业需完成碳成本核算与申报准备
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入全面实施阶段。届时进口商须购买CBAM证书，覆盖钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力及氢等品类。中国相关出口企业应尽快建立产品嵌入式碳排放核算体系，完善供应链数据，并评估在欧盟的申报义务与成本传导。建议企业提前与欧盟进口商沟通，明确数据提供责任，避免因申报不合规导致货物滞留或罚款。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM法规及过渡期实施指南 · 2026.11.24
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Nears Full Implementation: Chinese Exporters Must Prepare Carbon Accounting and Reporting
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period ends in late 2026, with full implementation from 2027. Importers will then need to purchase CBAM certificates for goods including steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Chinese exporters should establish embedded emissions accounting systems, improve supply chain data, and assess EU reporting obligations and cost pass-through. Early engagement with EU importers is advised to clarify data responsibilities and avoid shipment delays or penalties due to non-compliant reporting.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM Regulation and transitional guidance · 2026.11.24

case.title: 新加坡仲裁案：不可抗力条款在供应链中断中的解释与举证责任分配
case.summary: 某中国设备出口商与东南亚买方因疫情后物流中断引发交货争议，提交新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）仲裁。仲裁庭认为，不可抗力条款的适用需满足“不能合理预见、不能克服”要件，且主张方应承担举证责任。出口商因未能提供充分证据证明政府限制措施直接导致履约不能，其不可抗力抗辩未获支持。本案提示企业应在合同中明确不可抗力事件清单、通知义务及替代履行方案，并注重留存官方证明与沟通记录。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）典型案例摘要 · 2026年
case.title_en: SIAC Case: Interpretation of Force Majeure Clauses and Burden of Proof in Supply Chain Disruptions
case.summary_en: A Chinese equipment exporter and a Southeast Asian buyer disputed delivery after post-pandemic logistics disruptions, referred to SIAC arbitration. The tribunal held that invoking force majeure requires events to be unforeseeable and insurmountable, with the burden of proof on the claiming party. The exporter's defence failed due to insufficient evidence that government restrictions directly prevented performance. The case highlights the need for clear force majeure event lists, notice obligations, alternative performance plans, and retention of official certificates and communications.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) case summary · 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩展，企业需关注数据出境合规路径
policy.summary: 粤港澳大湾区近期进一步扩展跨境数据流动便利化措施，覆盖更多行业和场景，允许符合条件的企业通过标准合同、安全评估或认证等方式实现数据出境。政策强调个人信息保护与数据安全，要求企业开展数据分类分级，建立出境数据台账。建议大湾区企业梳理数据资产，评估出境场景，选择适当合规路径，并关注行业主管部门的具体指引，确保跨境业务数据流动合法有序。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室等大湾区数据跨境政策文件 · 2026年11月
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation: Compliance Pathways for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area has further expanded cross-border data flow facilitation measures, covering more industries and scenarios. Eligible enterprises may transfer data abroad via standard contracts, security assessments or certifications. The policy emphasises personal information protection and data security, requiring data classification and outbound data records. Enterprises are advised to map data assets, assess outbound scenarios, choose appropriate compliance pathways, and follow sector-specific guidance to ensure lawful cross-border data flows.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Cyberspace Administration and GBA cross-border data policies · November 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美对华出口管制穿透性规则升级，企业应构建全链条合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国近期调整出口管制规则，扩大对关联实体的许可要求，穿透性监管趋势明显。中国出海企业面临供应链溯源、最终用途审查及再出口风险。建议企业立即开展物项分类与客户筛查，完善内部合规制度，在合同中加入出口管制陈述保证与终止条款，并建立动态监控机制。同时，对涉及美国技术或零部件的产品，应评估替代方案与许可证申请路径，防范连带制裁风险。
analysis.source: 来源：美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）规则更新及实务观察 · 2026.11.24
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: US Export Controls Tighten with Penetrating Rules—Build a Full-Chain Compliance System
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US has recently adjusted export control rules, expanding licensing requirements for affiliated entities with a clear trend of penetrating regulation. Chinese going-global enterprises face supply chain tracing, end-use review and re-export risks. Companies should immediately classify items and screen customers, improve internal compliance programmes, include export control representations and termination clauses in contracts, and establish dynamic monitoring. For products involving US technology or components, assess alternatives and licensing paths to mitigate derivative sanctions risks.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) rule updates and practice observations · 2026.11.24
